rocker-cover-fillister-screw.name: Rocker Cover Fillister Screw
rocker-cover-fillister-screw.function: Fastens the stamped rocker cover to the cylinder head with lock washer security.
rocker-cover-fillister-screw.operatingConditions: Exposed to cylinder head fin temperatures up to 180 °C and engine vibration.

rocker-cover-plain-washer.name: Rocker Cover Plain Washer
rocker-cover-plain-washer.function: Distributes bolt clamping load over the rocker cover flange to prevent distortion.
rocker-cover-plain-washer.operatingConditions: Clamps cork/synthetic gasket to prevent oil seepage at rocker box.

rocker-cover-lock-washer.name: Rocker Cover Lock Washer
rocker-cover-lock-washer.material: Spring steel, internal tooth lock washer
rocker-cover-lock-washer.function: Prevents vibration loosening of the rocker cover screws during engine operation.
rocker-cover-lock-washer.operatingConditions: Maintains screw tension under continuous 3,200 rpm vibration spectrum.

valve-rocker-cover.name: Valve Rocker Cover
valve-rocker-cover.material: Deep-drawn stamped sheet steel, protective enamel finish
valve-rocker-cover.function: Encloses the rocker arms and valve springs, containing lubricating splash oil.
valve-rocker-cover.operatingConditions: Oil bath environment at 100–180 °C; external cooling air stream.

rocker-cover-gasket.name: Rocker Cover Gasket
rocker-cover-gasket.function: Seals the joint between the rocker box rim and the stamped steel rocker cover.
rocker-cover-gasket.operatingConditions: Compliant seal resisting hot synthetic/mineral oil at 140 °C.

rocker-shaft-retaining-screw.name: Rocker Shaft Retaining Screw
rocker-shaft-retaining-screw.function: Clamps the rocker shaft rigidly in its cylinder head support bosses.
rocker-shaft-retaining-screw.operatingConditions: Resists cyclic rocker thrust and reaction forces without loosening.

rocker-shaft-plain-washer.name: Rocker Shaft Plain Washer
rocker-shaft-plain-washer.function: Seats under the rocker shaft screw to distribute high clamping preload.
rocker-shaft-plain-washer.operatingConditions: Maintains preload against aluminum cylinder head boss.

rocker-shaft-lock-washer.name: Rocker Shaft Lock Washer
rocker-shaft-lock-washer.function: Locks the rocker shaft screw against vibrational backing-out.
rocker-shaft-lock-washer.operatingConditions: Vibrational environment directly on cylinder head casting.

rocker-shaft-locating-collar.name: Rocker Shaft Locating Collar
rocker-shaft-locating-collar.function: Axially positions and spaces the rocker arms along the rocker shaft.
rocker-shaft-locating-collar.operatingConditions: Maintains valve stem tip alignment over full valve lift travel.

rocker-shaft-end-retaining-ring.name: Rocker Shaft End Retaining Ring
rocker-shaft-end-retaining-ring.function: Secures the rocker shaft assembly axially in the cylinder head support towers.

rocker-shaft-retention-hardware.name: Rocker Shaft Retention Hardware
rocker-shaft-retention-hardware.function: Secures the rocker pivot assembly to the cylinder head structure.

cylinder-flange-hold-down-nut.name: Cylinder Flange Hold-Down Nut
cylinder-flange-hold-down-nut.function: Clamps the cylinder barrel mounting flange securely to the crankcase deck.
cylinder-flange-hold-down-nut.operatingConditions: Torqued to 490–510 in-lb to withstand peak firing pressures > 1,000 psi.
cylinder-flange-hold-down-nut.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 13 #2; Table 2 Torque Limits

cylinder-deck-attaching-stud.name: Cylinder Deck Attaching Stud
cylinder-deck-attaching-stud.material: Alloy steel, coarse case thread with fine nut thread (AMS 6320)
cylinder-deck-attaching-stud.function: Transfers cylinder gas pressure tension directly into the crankcase structure.
cylinder-deck-attaching-stud.operatingConditions: Cyclic tensile loads up to 45 kN per cylinder power stroke.
cylinder-deck-attaching-stud.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 4 #9; Table 9 Setting Heights

cylinder-base-locking-palnut.name: Cylinder Base Locking Palnut
cylinder-base-locking-palnut.function: Locks the primary cylinder base flanged nut against vibrational loosening.
cylinder-base-locking-palnut.operatingConditions: Installed finger-tight plus 1/3 turn over the primary nut.

crankcase-main-through-bolt.name: Crankcase Main Through-Bolt
crankcase-main-through-bolt.function: Passes across the crankcase to clamp both halves tightly across the main bearings.
crankcase-main-through-bolt.operatingConditions: Torqued to 700–750 in-lb, clamping crankshaft main bearing shells.

crankcase-flange-through-bolt.name: Crankcase Flange Through-Bolt
crankcase-flange-through-bolt.function: Clamps perimeter mating flanges of the crankcase halves together.
crankcase-flange-through-bolt.operatingConditions: Maintains oil-tight seal across metal-to-metal crankcase spine.

crankcase-through-bolt-hardened-washer.name: Crankcase Through-Bolt Hardened Washer
crankcase-through-bolt-hardened-washer.function: Distributes through-bolt nut clamping force without galling the aluminum case.
crankcase-through-bolt-hardened-washer.operatingConditions: High compressive preload under main bearing clamp.

crankcase-through-bolt-flanged-locknut.name: Crankcase Through-Bolt Flanged Locknut
crankcase-through-bolt-flanged-locknut.function: High-load flanged nut securing the primary crankcase transverse through-bolts.

crankcase-perimeter-fastener.name: Crankcase Perimeter Fastener
crankcase-perimeter-fastener.material: Aircraft structural steel bolt / self-locking nut
crankcase-perimeter-fastener.function: Secures outer split-line seam of crankcase halves.
crankcase-perimeter-fastener.operatingConditions: Maintains case alignment and prevents oil weeping.

reduction-housing-split-lock-washer.name: Reduction Housing Split Lock Washer
reduction-housing-split-lock-washer.material: High-carbon spring steel split lock washer
reduction-housing-split-lock-washer.function: Maintains bolt tension clamping the front reduction nose case.

nose-reduction-housing-fastener.name: Nose Reduction Housing Fastener
nose-reduction-housing-fastener.function: Fastens the forward reduction gear nose housing to the crankcase front flange.
nose-reduction-housing-fastener.operatingConditions: Reacts propeller thrust and gyroscopic bending moments.

connecting-rod.name: Connecting Rod
connecting-rod.material: Forged H-section alloy steel, shot-peened for fatigue endurance
connecting-rod.function: Transmits reciprocating gas forces from the piston pin to the crankshaft crankpin.
connecting-rod.operatingConditions: Alternating tension/compression loads exceeding 35 kN at 3,200 engine rpm.
connecting-rod.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 11 #1; Overhaul Manual Table 6

connecting-rod-big-end-cap.name: Connecting Rod Big-End Cap
connecting-rod-big-end-cap.material: Matched forged alloy steel forging with precision doweled alignment
connecting-rod-big-end-cap.function: Clamps the lower rod bearing shell to the crankpin journal under high inertia.
connecting-rod-big-end-cap.operatingConditions: Subjected to centrifugal and inertia tension during exhaust stroke TDC.

connecting-rod-upper-bearing-shell.name: Connecting Rod Upper Bearing Shell
connecting-rod-upper-bearing-shell.material: Steel-backed copper-lead lining with electroplated lead-tin babbitt overlay
connecting-rod-upper-bearing-shell.function: Carries maximum combustion firing loads between rod small end and crankpin.
connecting-rod-upper-bearing-shell.operatingConditions: Dynamic hydrodynamic oil film under peak unit loads > 3,500 psi.

connecting-rod-lower-bearing-shell.name: Connecting Rod Lower Bearing Shell
connecting-rod-lower-bearing-shell.material: Steel-backed trimetal copper-lead alloy shell with babbitt running surface
connecting-rod-lower-bearing-shell.function: Provides low-friction hydrodynamic journal support during inertia load reversals.
connecting-rod-lower-bearing-shell.operatingConditions: Hydrodynamic film lubricated by pressurized crankpin oil drilling.

connecting-rod-piston-pin-bushing.name: Connecting Rod Piston Pin Bushing
connecting-rod-piston-pin-bushing.function: Provides bearing journal for the full-floating wrist pin in the rod small end.
connecting-rod-piston-pin-bushing.operatingConditions: High oscillating bearing pressure under boundary oil mist lubrication.

connecting-rod-precision-bolt.name: Connecting Rod Precision Bolt
connecting-rod-precision-bolt.material: Vacuum-arc remelted alloy steel (AMS 6304), precision ground body
connecting-rod-precision-bolt.function: Clamps connecting rod cap to rod body with calibrated stretch.
connecting-rod-precision-bolt.operatingConditions: Preloaded to 400–450 in-lb; carries continuous inertia cyclic tension.

connecting-rod-slotted-nut.name: Connecting Rod Slotted Nut
connecting-rod-slotted-nut.function: Secures the rod bolt clamping preload, locked with a stainless cotter pin.
connecting-rod-slotted-nut.operatingConditions: Maintains calibrated bolt stretch under 3,200 rpm alternating fatigue.

connecting-rod-cotter-pin.name: Connecting Rod Cotter Pin
connecting-rod-cotter-pin.function: Positively locks the slotted rod nut to the connecting rod bolt shank.
connecting-rod-cotter-pin.operatingConditions: Zero-failure positive mechanical locking in high centrifugal oil bath.

piston-wrist-pin.name: Piston Wrist Pin
piston-wrist-pin.material: High-nickel carburizing alloy steel, case-hardened and ground
piston-wrist-pin.function: Transfers reciprocating piston pressure forces to the connecting rod small end.
piston-wrist-pin.operatingConditions: Full-floating design free to rotate in piston bosses and rod bushing.

piston-pin-end-plug.name: Piston Pin End Plug
piston-pin-end-plug.material: Wrought aluminum alloy (AMS 4120), spherical contact face
piston-pin-end-plug.function: Prevents the hardened steel wrist pin from contacting and scoring the cylinder wall.
piston-pin-end-plug.operatingConditions: Slides smoothly against nitrided cylinder barrel at top and bottom of stroke.

piston-body.name: Piston Body
piston-body.material: Forged aluminum alloy (Al-Cu-Mg-Ni 2618-T61), cam-ground barrel skirt
piston-body.function: Forms movable boundary of combustion chamber; transfers gas pressure to pin.
piston-body.operatingConditions: Crown exposed to combustion flame > 1,800 °C; crown metal temperature up to 280 °C.

top-compression-piston-ring.name: Top Compression Piston Ring
top-compression-piston-ring.material: High-strength ductile alloy iron, hard chrome-plated keystone profile
top-compression-piston-ring.function: Primary combustion seal holding peak firing pressures; conducts crown heat to barrel.
top-compression-piston-ring.operatingConditions: Exposed directly to flame front; wedge keystone profile prevents groove sticking.

second-compression-piston-ring.name: Second Compression Piston Ring
second-compression-piston-ring.material: High-grade alloy cast iron, tapered face running profile
second-compression-piston-ring.function: Secondary gas seal and oil wiper ring controlling cylinder wall lubrication.
second-compression-piston-ring.operatingConditions: Scrapes excess oil downward while maintaining combustion gas seal.

third-groove-oil-control-ring.name: Third Groove Oil Control Ring
third-groove-oil-control-ring.material: Slotted alloy cast iron with internal helical spring expander
third-groove-oil-control-ring.function: Meters and scrapes lubricating oil film on cylinder bore to control consumption.
third-groove-oil-control-ring.operatingConditions: Channels surplus oil through piston drainage ports back to crankcase sump.

fourth-groove-skirt-scraper-ring.name: Fourth Groove Skirt Scraper Ring
fourth-groove-skirt-scraper-ring.function: Wipes oil from lower cylinder skirt to prevent excess oil reaching combustion chamber.
fourth-groove-skirt-scraper-ring.operatingConditions: Lower skirt ring groove running in crankcase splash zone.

cylinder-barrel.name: Cylinder Barrel
cylinder-barrel.material: Forged chrome-molybdenum alloy steel (AMS 6382), nitrided choke bore
cylinder-barrel.function: Provides durable, wear-resistant reciprocating bore for piston and rings.
cylinder-barrel.operatingConditions: Bore diameter 5.250 in; choke-ground at top to compensate for thermal expansion.
cylinder-barrel.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 13 #6; Overhaul Manual Table 6

cylinder-head.name: Cylinder Head
cylinder-head.material: Gravity-cast aluminum alloy (A355-T61) with integral deep cooling fins
cylinder-head.function: Encloses combustion chamber, houses valves, guides, seats, and spark plugs.
cylinder-head.operatingConditions: Thermal gradient from 180 °C (intake) to 240 °C (exhaust); shrunk onto barrel.

cylinder-base-packing-o-ring.name: Cylinder Base Packing O-Ring
cylinder-base-packing-o-ring.function: Seals the cylinder flange pilot spigot in the crankcase deck bore against oil leakage.
cylinder-base-packing-o-ring.operatingConditions: Stationary radial compression seal resisting 150 °C oil bath.

intake-valve.name: Intake Valve
intake-valve.material: Low-alloy silicon-chromium steel (AMS 6440) with 30 deg ground seating face
intake-valve.function: Admits fuel-air mixture from the intake port into the cylinder during intake stroke.
intake-valve.operatingConditions: Head diameter 2.25 in; cooled by incoming induction charge to 300–400 °C.
intake-valve.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 13 #13; Overhaul Manual Table 6

exhaust-valve.name: Exhaust Valve
exhaust-valve.material: High-nickel austenitic steel stem, hollow sodium-filled cavity, Stellite face
exhaust-valve.function: Releases burnt exhaust gases to exhaust port; transfers head heat via liquid sodium.
exhaust-valve.operatingConditions: Internal sodium melts at 98 °C, transferring heat to guide; head operates at 650–750 °C.
exhaust-valve.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 13 #14; Overhaul Manual Table 6

intake-valve-seat-insert.name: Intake Valve Seat Insert
intake-valve-seat-insert.material: Austenitic alloy steel with precision ground 30 deg sealing cone
intake-valve-seat-insert.function: Provides hard, wear-resistant sealing surface for intake valve face.
intake-valve-seat-insert.operatingConditions: Shrunk into heated cylinder head with 0.007 in interference fit.

exhaust-valve-seat-insert.name: Exhaust Valve Seat Insert
exhaust-valve-seat-insert.material: Ni-Resist austenitic high-nickel cast iron alloy
exhaust-valve-seat-insert.function: Seals exhaust valve under continuous high-temperature gas erosion.
exhaust-valve-seat-insert.operatingConditions: Withstands 700 °C combustion gas impingement and severe thermal cycling.

intake-valve-guide.name: Intake Valve Guide
intake-valve-guide.function: Accurately guides intake valve stem and transfers stem heat to aluminum head.
intake-valve-guide.operatingConditions: Shrunk into head bore; running clearance 0.0010–0.0024 in.
intake-valve-guide.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 13 #8; Overhaul Manual Table 6

exhaust-valve-guide.name: Exhaust Valve Guide
exhaust-valve-guide.function: Guides exhaust valve stem and dissipates high sodium-conducted heat flux.
exhaust-valve-guide.operatingConditions: Running clearance 0.0015–0.0030 in; absorbs bulk of valve heat dissipation.
exhaust-valve-guide.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 13 #8; Overhaul Manual Table 6

valve-outer-spring.name: Valve Outer Spring
valve-outer-spring.function: Primary spring returning valve to seat and preventing float at 3,200 engine rpm.
valve-outer-spring.operatingConditions: Compressed load 80–90 lb installed, 180–200 lb at full valve lift.
valve-outer-spring.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 13 #16; Overhaul Manual Table 6

valve-inner-spring.name: Valve Inner Spring
valve-inner-spring.function: Dampens harmonic surge of outer spring and provides failsafe seating force.
valve-inner-spring.operatingConditions: Wound in opposite direction to outer spring to prevent coil interlocking.

valve-spring-lower-seat-washer.name: Valve Spring Lower Seat Washer
valve-spring-lower-seat-washer.function: Protects aluminum cylinder head casting from spring coil wear and fretting.
valve-spring-lower-seat-washer.operatingConditions: Stationary thrust face under spring stack preload.

valve-spring-lower-inner-retainer.name: Valve Spring Lower Inner Retainer
valve-spring-lower-inner-retainer.function: Locates the inner valve spring concentric with the valve guide boss.
valve-spring-lower-inner-retainer.operatingConditions: Static centering cup under inner spring base.

intake-valve-upper-spring-retainer.name: Intake Valve Upper Spring Retainer
intake-valve-upper-spring-retainer.function: Transfers dual spring force to the split tapered keepers on the intake valve stem.
intake-valve-upper-spring-retainer.operatingConditions: Reciprocates at valve speed with alternating spring acceleration loads.

exhaust-valve-roto-cap-assembly.name: Exhaust Valve Roto-Cap Assembly
exhaust-valve-roto-cap-assembly.material: Precision spring steel Belleville washer, ball bearings, and steel retainer cup
exhaust-valve-roto-cap-assembly.function: Rotates exhaust valve slightly each stroke to prevent hot spots and seat carbon buildup.
exhaust-valve-roto-cap-assembly.operatingConditions: Induces 1–4 degrees of valve rotation per lift cycle under spring compression.

valve-stem-split-tapered-keeper-key.name: Valve Stem Split Tapered Keeper Key
valve-stem-split-tapered-keeper-key.function: Locks the upper spring retainer into the circumferential groove on the valve stem.
valve-stem-split-tapered-keeper-key.operatingConditions: Self-wedging taper lock supporting full 200 lb spring tension.

intake-valve-rocker-arm.name: Intake Valve Rocker Arm
intake-valve-rocker-arm.material: Forged alloy steel, hardened pad and bronze pivot bushing
intake-valve-rocker-arm.function: Multiplies and redirects pushrod upward motion into downward valve opening lift.
intake-valve-rocker-arm.operatingConditions: Rocker ratio 1.5:1; contact pad lubricated by pressurized pushrod oil.

exhaust-valve-rocker-arm.name: Exhaust Valve Rocker Arm
exhaust-valve-rocker-arm.material: Forged alloy steel, induction hardened roller/pad nose
exhaust-valve-rocker-arm.function: Opens exhaust valve against combustion pressure and dual spring resistance.
exhaust-valve-rocker-arm.operatingConditions: Transmits valve opening force up to 250 lb during exhaust valve crack.

valve-rocker-shaft.name: Valve Rocker Shaft
valve-rocker-shaft.material: Case-hardened precision ground alloy steel shaft
valve-rocker-shaft.function: Forms stationary pivot axis for intake and exhaust rocker arms in cylinder head.
valve-rocker-shaft.operatingConditions: Surface hardness HRC 58–62; fed pressurized oil to lubricate rocker bushings.

rocker-arm-bronze-bushing.name: Rocker Arm Bronze Bushing
rocker-arm-bronze-bushing.function: Low-friction oscillating journal bearing pressed into rocker arm bore.
rocker-arm-bronze-bushing.operatingConditions: Boundary/hydrodynamic oscillating lubrication under valve lift loads.

pushrod-assembly.name: Pushrod Assembly
pushrod-assembly.material: Seamless cold-drawn alloy steel tube with welded case-hardened ball ends
pushrod-assembly.function: Transfers cam lifter upward displacement to the rocker arm; delivers lubricating oil.
pushrod-assembly.operatingConditions: Hollow core conducts pressurized oil from lifter to cylinder head rocker gear.

pushrod-shroud-tube.name: Pushrod Shroud Tube
pushrod-shroud-tube.material: Seamless aluminum alloy tubing, flared seating ends
pushrod-shroud-tube.function: Encloses pushrod between crankcase and cylinder head; drains return oil to sump.
pushrod-shroud-tube.operatingConditions: Telescoping spring-loaded tube accommodating thermal expansion of cylinder.

pushrod-shroud-tension-spring.name: Pushrod Shroud Tension Spring
pushrod-shroud-tension-spring.function: Keeps constant compressive tension on pushrod shroud silicone seal rings.
pushrod-shroud-tension-spring.operatingConditions: Maintains oil-tight seal despite engine expansion and contraction.

pushrod-shroud-silicone-seal-ring.name: Pushrod Shroud Silicone Seal Ring
pushrod-shroud-silicone-seal-ring.function: Seals the ends of the pushrod shroud tube at crankcase and cylinder head ports.
pushrod-shroud-silicone-seal-ring.operatingConditions: Resists hot engine oil at 150 °C without hardening or oil weeping.

pushrod-shroud-retaining-washer.name: Pushrod Shroud Retaining Washer
pushrod-shroud-retaining-washer.function: Provides positive spring seat backing for the pushrod shroud tension spring.
pushrod-shroud-retaining-washer.operatingConditions: Distributes spring force evenly onto silicone seal packing.

spark-plug-heli-coil-thread-insert.name: Spark Plug Heli-Coil Thread Insert
spark-plug-heli-coil-thread-insert.material: Phosphor bronze / stainless steel 18 mm Heli-Coil thread insert
spark-plug-heli-coil-thread-insert.function: Provides durable high-strength threads in aluminum head for spark plug installation.
spark-plug-heli-coil-thread-insert.operatingConditions: Resists spark plug installation torque of 300–360 in-lb and combustion heat.

spark-plug-shielded-steel-shell.name: Spark Plug Shielded Steel Shell
spark-plug-shielded-steel-shell.material: Machined carbon steel, corrosion-resistant black oxide finish (18 mm thread)
spark-plug-shielded-steel-shell.function: Threaded body anchoring plug into cylinder head and grounding the spark gap.
spark-plug-shielded-steel-shell.operatingConditions: Hermetic seal holding 1,000 psi combustion pressure; 18 mm x 1.5 mm reach.
spark-plug-shielded-steel-shell.source: Champion Aviation Spark Plug Catalog RHB32E

spark-plug-ceramic-insulator.name: Spark Plug Ceramic Insulator
spark-plug-ceramic-insulator.function: Insulates high-voltage ignition pulse (up to 25 kV) from ground.
spark-plug-ceramic-insulator.operatingConditions: Dielectric breakdown resistance > 30 kV; thermal shock resistant.
spark-plug-ceramic-insulator.source: Champion Aviation Spark Plug Catalog RHB32E

spark-plug-shielded-terminal.name: Spark Plug Shielded Terminal
spark-plug-shielded-terminal.material: Brass contact with 5/8-24 shielded ignition lead connection
spark-plug-shielded-terminal.function: Connects magneto high-tension harness lead inside a radio-shielded housing.
spark-plug-shielded-terminal.operatingConditions: Prevents radio frequency interference (RFI) with aircraft avionics.
spark-plug-shielded-terminal.source: Champion Aviation Spark Plug Catalog RHB32E

spark-plug-copper-crush-washer.name: Spark Plug Copper Crush Washer
spark-plug-copper-crush-washer.material: Solid annealed copper annular crush gasket
spark-plug-copper-crush-washer.function: Deforms under tightening torque to create gas-tight seal against cylinder head.
spark-plug-copper-crush-washer.operatingConditions: Single-use crush washer torqued to 300–360 in-lb.

aviation-shielded-spark-plug.name: Aviation Shielded Spark Plug
aviation-shielded-spark-plug.material: Heavy-duty aviation shielded spark plug (18 mm, dual ground electrodes)
aviation-shielded-spark-plug.function: Ignites compressed fuel-air charge at timed crank angle (20–22 deg BTDC).
aviation-shielded-spark-plug.operatingConditions: Dual ignition system: two plugs per cylinder fired by independent magnetos.
aviation-shielded-spark-plug.source: Continental GTSIO-520 Overhaul Manual Sec. X

hydraulic-valve-tappet-lifter.name: Hydraulic Valve Tappet / Lifter
hydraulic-valve-tappet-lifter.material: Chilled cast alloy iron face with precision-honed steel body
hydraulic-valve-tappet-lifter.function: Eliminates mechanical valvetrain lash automatically using engine oil pressure.
hydraulic-valve-tappet-lifter.operatingConditions: Runs directly on camshaft lobe; maintains zero lash over entire engine thermal range.
hydraulic-valve-tappet-lifter.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 9 #4; Overhaul Manual Table 6

hydraulic-lifter-outer-body.name: Hydraulic Lifter Outer Body
hydraulic-lifter-outer-body.material: High-carbon alloy steel, hardened chilled iron foot (HRC 58 min)
hydraulic-lifter-outer-body.function: Rides cam lobe and guides internal hydraulic plunger in crankcase lifter bore.
hydraulic-lifter-outer-body.operatingConditions: Reciprocates in crankcase bore with 0.0015 in diametral clearance.

hydraulic-lifter-plunger.name: Hydraulic Lifter Plunger
hydraulic-lifter-plunger.material: Precision ground alloy steel, select-fitted to body bore
hydraulic-lifter-plunger.function: Traps high-pressure oil column in lower chamber to transmit cam lift solidly.
hydraulic-lifter-plunger.operatingConditions: Controlled oil bleed-down rate tested under 50 lb load in kerosene bath.

hydraulic-lifter-plunger-spring.name: Hydraulic Lifter Plunger Spring
hydraulic-lifter-plunger-spring.function: Expands plunger outward against pushrod socket when valvetrain is off the cam lobe.
hydraulic-lifter-plunger-spring.operatingConditions: Light expansion force taking up lash during base circle dwell.

hydraulic-lifter-pushrod-socket.name: Hydraulic Lifter Pushrod Socket
hydraulic-lifter-pushrod-socket.material: Case-hardened steel hemispherical seat with central oil feed hole
hydraulic-lifter-pushrod-socket.function: Provides spherical cup bearing for lower pushrod ball; meters oil to hollow pushrod.
hydraulic-lifter-pushrod-socket.operatingConditions: Transfers full valve opening thrust from plunger to pushrod.

hydraulic-lifter-retaining-ring.name: Hydraulic Lifter Retaining Ring
hydraulic-lifter-retaining-ring.function: Retains socket and plunger inside lifter body during assembly and handling.
hydraulic-lifter-retaining-ring.operatingConditions: Internal snap groove at open top of lifter body.

dynamic-counterweight-pendulum-damper.name: Dynamic Counterweight Pendulum Damper
dynamic-counterweight-pendulum-damper.material: Forged high-density alloy steel, precision ground fork ears
dynamic-counterweight-pendulum-damper.function: Absorbs crankshaft torsional vibrations by oscillating as a tuned centrifugal pendulum.
dynamic-counterweight-pendulum-damper.operatingConditions: Tuned to 4th and 5th engine harmonic orders to prevent crankshaft fatigue failure.
dynamic-counterweight-pendulum-damper.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 7 #18; Overhaul Manual Table 11

crankshaft-damper-blade-bushing.name: Crankshaft Damper Blade Bushing
crankshaft-damper-blade-bushing.material: Case-hardened precision ground alloy steel race
crankshaft-damper-blade-bushing.function: Forms hardened inner track in crankshaft cheek for the floating damper pin.
crankshaft-damper-blade-bushing.operatingConditions: High rolling contact stresses under centrifugal pendulum acceleration.

counterweight-fork-bushing.name: Counterweight Fork Bushing
counterweight-fork-bushing.material: Hardened alloy steel race pressed into counterweight fork ears
counterweight-fork-bushing.function: Provides outer rolling track for the floating stepped damper pin.
counterweight-fork-bushing.operatingConditions: Rolling pendulum oscillation under 3,200 rpm centrifugal field.

damper-pin-retaining-plate.name: Damper Pin Retaining Plate
damper-pin-retaining-plate.function: Prevents axial migration of the floating damper pin out of its bushing tracks.
damper-pin-retaining-plate.operatingConditions: Kept in place by circular spring retaining snap ring.

damper-plate-retaining-snap-ring.name: Damper Plate Retaining Snap Ring
damper-plate-retaining-snap-ring.material: High-carbon spring steel gapped snap ring
damper-plate-retaining-snap-ring.function: Locks the damper pin retaining plate into the counterweight counterbore.

damper-dynamic-stepped-pin.name: Damper Dynamic Stepped Pin
damper-dynamic-stepped-pin.material: Vacuum-arc remelted steel, carburized, ground, and micro-honed
damper-dynamic-stepped-pin.function: Rolls inside crankshaft and counterweight bushings, defining the pendulum radius.
damper-dynamic-stepped-pin.operatingConditions: Diameter difference defines exact order tuning (4th harmonic or 5th harmonic).

crankshaft-damper-bushing.name: Crankshaft Damper Bushing
crankshaft-damper-bushing.function: Provides precision rolling bore for counterweight dynamic pendulum pin.
crankshaft-damper-bushing.operatingConditions: High rolling fatigue endurance under torsional harmonic oscillation.

crankshaft.name: Crankshaft
crankshaft.material: Vacuum-arc remelted forged alloy steel (AMS 6415), gas nitrided journals
crankshaft.function: Converts six reciprocating piston forces into rotational output torque.
crankshaft.operatingConditions: Six throws at 120 deg; journals nitrided to 0.025 in case depth; 3,200 rpm rated speed.
crankshaft.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 7 #1; Overhaul Manual Table 6

crankshaft-main-bearing-shell.name: Crankshaft Main Bearing Shell
crankshaft-main-bearing-shell.material: Steel-backed copper-lead lining with lead-tin electroplated babbitt overlay
crankshaft-main-bearing-shell.function: Supports the rotating crankshaft journals in the crankcase main bearing saddles.
crankshaft-main-bearing-shell.operatingConditions: Hydrodynamic oil film continuously fed from crankcase oil galleries.
crankshaft-main-bearing-shell.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 8 #13; Overhaul Manual Table 6

crankshaft-main-thrust-washer.name: Crankshaft Main Thrust Washer
crankshaft-main-thrust-washer.material: High-strength tin-bronze / babbitt faced thrust washer
crankshaft-main-thrust-washer.function: Carries axial crankshaft end-thrust and controls crankshaft end-play.
crankshaft-main-thrust-washer.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 7 #13; Overhaul Manual Table 6

crankshaft-timing-pinion-gear.name: Crankshaft Timing Pinion Gear
crankshaft-timing-pinion-gear.material: Carburized and hardened alloy steel spur gear
crankshaft-timing-pinion-gear.function: Drives the camshaft gear at 1:2 ratio and powers the rear accessory gear trains.
crankshaft-timing-pinion-gear.operatingConditions: Doweled directly to the rear flange of the crankshaft.

camshaft.name: Camshaft
camshaft.material: Chilled alloy cast iron, induction-hardened cam lobes (HRC 55 min)
camshaft.function: Controls timing, lift, and duration of the 12 intake and exhaust valves.
camshaft.operatingConditions: Rotates at 1/2 crankshaft speed (1,600 rpm at 3,200 engine rpm) on four journal bearings.
camshaft.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 9 #2; Overhaul Manual Table 6

camshaft-gear-attaching-screw.name: Camshaft Gear Attaching Screw
camshaft-gear-attaching-screw.function: Fastens the camshaft timing gear and cluster gear to the camshaft rear flange.
camshaft-gear-attaching-screw.operatingConditions: Torqued and safety wired to maintain critical valve timing synchronization.

camshaft-timing-spur-gear.name: Camshaft Timing Spur Gear
camshaft-timing-spur-gear.material: Forged alloy steel, precision ground teeth
camshaft-timing-spur-gear.function: Meshes with crankshaft pinion gear to rotate camshaft at half crankshaft speed.
camshaft-timing-spur-gear.operatingConditions: Timing marks aligned to guarantee valve event phasing relative to pistons.

camshaft-cluster-drive-gear.name: Camshaft Cluster Drive Gear
camshaft-cluster-drive-gear.function: Powers governor drive, tachometer, and auxiliary accessories from the camshaft.
camshaft-cluster-drive-gear.operatingConditions: Transmits auxiliary drive loads smoothly off the camshaft rear end.

camshaft-drive-gear-train.name: Camshaft Drive Gear Train
camshaft-drive-gear-train.function: Synchronizes valvetrain camshaft rotation with crankshaft rotation.
camshaft-drive-gear-train.operatingConditions: Operates at half engine speed in pressurized oil mist.

propeller-flexible-quill-shaft.name: Propeller Flexible Quill Shaft
propeller-flexible-quill-shaft.material: High-strength aircraft spring steel, precision ground torsional shaft
propeller-flexible-quill-shaft.function: Acts as a torsional spring isolating propeller inertia from crankshaft engine pulses.
propeller-flexible-quill-shaft.operatingConditions: Transmits 375 hp at 3,200 rpm while dampening torsional shock loads.
propeller-flexible-quill-shaft.source: Overhaul Manual X-30045A Sec. III General Description

propeller-drive-reduction-pinion.name: Propeller Drive Reduction Pinion
propeller-drive-reduction-pinion.material: Carburized alloy steel (AMS 6260), case-hardened helical/spur teeth
propeller-drive-reduction-pinion.function: Driving pinion on front of crankshaft/quill driving the reduction bull gear.
propeller-drive-reduction-pinion.operatingConditions: 0.667:1 gear reduction ratio: engine 3,200 rpm yields propeller 2,133 rpm.
propeller-drive-reduction-pinion.source: Overhaul Manual X-30045A Sec. III & Fig. A-4-41

propeller-reduction-bull-gear.name: Propeller Reduction Bull Gear
propeller-reduction-bull-gear.material: Forged alloy steel, case-hardened precision ground internal/external gear
propeller-reduction-bull-gear.function: Driven bull gear mounted on the propeller output shaft for speed reduction.
propeller-reduction-bull-gear.operatingConditions: High torque transmission at 2,133 propeller rpm with minimum gear noise.

propeller-output-shaft.name: Propeller Output Shaft
propeller-output-shaft.material: Heavy-duty forged alloy steel, hollow bore for propeller governor oil tube
propeller-output-shaft.function: Output shaft delivering engine power to the aircraft constant-speed propeller.
propeller-output-shaft.operatingConditions: SAE No. 20 splined propeller mounting flange with high thrust capacity.
propeller-output-shaft.source: Overhaul Manual X-30045A Sec. III & Table 6

propeller-thrust-journal-bearing.name: Propeller Thrust & Journal Bearing
propeller-thrust-journal-bearing.material: High-capacity deep-groove ball bearing / heavy-duty cylindrical roller bearing
propeller-thrust-journal-bearing.function: Carries forward aircraft propeller thrust loads (up to 2,000 lb) directly into the nose case.
propeller-thrust-journal-bearing.operatingConditions: Operates under continuous forward thrust and gyroscopic aircraft flight loads.
propeller-thrust-journal-bearing.source: Overhaul Manual X-30045A Sec. III & Table 6

propeller-pitch-control-oil-transfer-col.name: Propeller Pitch Control Oil Transfer Collar
propeller-pitch-control-oil-transfer-col.material: Precision bronze sleeve with stationary ground oil transfer ports & O-rings
propeller-pitch-control-oil-transfer-col.function: Transfers high-pressure engine oil into the rotating propeller shaft to control blade pitch.
propeller-pitch-control-oil-transfer-col.operatingConditions: Seals governor oil pressure up to 300 psi across rotating joint.

propeller-shaft-front-oil-seal.name: Propeller Shaft Front Oil Seal
propeller-shaft-front-oil-seal.material: Synthetic fluorocarbon elastomer with stainless garter spring in metal case
propeller-shaft-front-oil-seal.function: Hermetically seals the front nose case opening around the rotating propeller shaft.
propeller-shaft-front-oil-seal.operatingConditions: Prevents engine oil loss into propeller hub under flight airspeed pressure.

reduction-gear-retaining-hardware.name: Reduction Gear Retaining Hardware
reduction-gear-retaining-hardware.material: High-tensile alloy steel plate, screws, and internal retaining ring
reduction-gear-retaining-hardware.function: Positively locks the reduction pinion and quill shaft axially in the reduction nose case.
reduction-gear-retaining-hardware.operatingConditions: Carries axial gear thrust reaction forces under load.

front-gear-reduction-drive-assembly.name: Front Gear Reduction Drive Assembly
front-gear-reduction-drive-assembly.material: Precision reduction gearing and housing subassembly
front-gear-reduction-drive-assembly.function: Provides speed reduction and propeller vibration isolation.

crankcase-left-half.name: Crankcase Left Half
crankcase-left-half.material: Permanent-mold cast aluminum alloy (A355-T61), heat treated and aged
crankcase-left-half.function: Left structural foundation of engine; houses cylinders 2, 4, 6 and left main saddles.
crankcase-left-half.operatingConditions: High rigidity casting with integral oil galleries, lifter guides, and engine mounts.
crankcase-left-half.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 1 #1; Overhaul Manual Sec. IV

crankcase-right-half.name: Crankcase Right Half
crankcase-right-half.material: Permanent-mold cast aluminum alloy (A355-T61), chromate conversion coated
crankcase-right-half.function: Right structural foundation of engine; houses cylinders 1, 3, 5 and right main saddles.
crankcase-right-half.operatingConditions: Gold-dichromate finish; matched with left half by precision doweled line-boring.
crankcase-right-half.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 1 #1; Overhaul Manual Sec. IV

crankcase-halves-assembly.name: Crankcase Halves Assembly
crankcase-halves-assembly.material: Matched pair line-bored permanent-mold aluminum castings
crankcase-halves-assembly.function: Main structural skeleton supporting the crankshaft, camshaft, and six cylinders.
crankcase-halves-assembly.operatingConditions: Contains internal lubrication passages and reacts all dynamic engine loads.

accessory-idler-gear-support-pin.name: Accessory Idler Gear Support Pin
accessory-idler-gear-support-pin.material: Case-hardened alloy steel pin, ground finish with copper gasket
accessory-idler-gear-support-pin.function: Pressed into rear crankcase to support rotating accessory drive idler gear.
accessory-idler-gear-support-pin.operatingConditions: Carries accessory gear drive torque reaction with pressurized oil feed.

accessory-drive-idler-gear.name: Accessory Drive Idler Gear
accessory-drive-idler-gear.material: Carburized alloy steel with pressed bronze bushing
accessory-drive-idler-gear.function: Transfers drive power from crankshaft rear gear to starter, alternator, and oil pump.
accessory-drive-idler-gear.operatingConditions: Rotates on hardened idler pin in continuous oil bath.

idler-cluster-gear-screw.name: Idler Cluster Gear Screw
idler-cluster-gear-screw.function: Fastens cluster gear to idler gear body.
idler-cluster-gear-screw.operatingConditions: Torqued and locked with tab washer.

accessory-drive-housing-bolt.name: Accessory Drive Housing Bolt
accessory-drive-housing-bolt.function: Secures accessory gear covers to crankcase rear accessory pad.

engine-oil-pump-housing.name: Engine Oil Pump Housing
engine-oil-pump-housing.material: Precision cast aluminum alloy, line-bored gear cavities
engine-oil-pump-housing.function: Houses positive displacement gear-type pressure oil pump and tach drive gears.
engine-oil-pump-housing.operatingConditions: Delivers 30–60 psi lubricating oil pressure across all engine operating ranges.

oil-pump-driven-gear-spindle.name: Oil Pump Driven Gear & Spindle
oil-pump-driven-gear-spindle.material: Hardened alloy steel spur gear with integral bronze journal bushing
oil-pump-driven-gear-spindle.function: Driven spur gear meshing with drive gear to pump pressurized engine oil.
oil-pump-driven-gear-spindle.operatingConditions: Positive displacement pumping capacity 10–15 gpm at full engine rpm.

oil-pump-drive-gear.name: Oil Pump Drive Gear
oil-pump-drive-gear.material: Carburized alloy steel gear integral with drive shaft
oil-pump-drive-gear.function: Drives oil pump gears from the engine accessory gear train.
oil-pump-drive-gear.operatingConditions: Transmits oil pumping power directly from camshaft/idler gear.

oil-pressure-relief-valve-assembly.name: Oil Pressure Relief Valve Assembly
oil-pressure-relief-valve-assembly.material: Precision ground steel plunger, calibrated spring, and threaded adjustment cap
oil-pressure-relief-valve-assembly.function: Regulates main oil gallery pressure by bypassing excess pump flow to the sump.
oil-pressure-relief-valve-assembly.operatingConditions: Maintains nominal 40–60 psi oil pressure across variable engine speeds and oil temps.

full-flow-engine-oil-filter.name: Full-Flow Engine Oil Filter
full-flow-engine-oil-filter.material: Drawn steel canister with pleated resin-impregnated cellulose filter element
full-flow-engine-oil-filter.function: Filters all oil delivered to engine bearings; traps particulates down to 15 microns.
full-flow-engine-oil-filter.operatingConditions: Equipped with internal pressure relief bypass valve in case of filter clogging.

turbocharger-oil-scavenge-pump.name: Turbocharger Oil Scavenge Pump
turbocharger-oil-scavenge-pump.material: Cast aluminum housing with steel scavenge gears
turbocharger-oil-scavenge-pump.function: Pumps return oil from the turbocharger bearing housing back up to the engine sump.
turbocharger-oil-scavenge-pump.operatingConditions: Continuous dual-phase oil/vapor scavenging against gravity.

engine-oil-sump.name: Engine Oil Sump
engine-oil-sump.material: Permanent-mold cast aluminum alloy, internal anti-slosh baffles
engine-oil-sump.function: Reservoir holding 12 quarts of engine lubricating oil; houses oil pickup screen.
engine-oil-sump.operatingConditions: Bolted to bottom of crankcase; provides oil cooling surface and sump drainage.

oil-gallery-pipe-plug-closure.name: Oil Gallery Pipe Plug Closure
oil-gallery-pipe-plug-closure.material: Hex-socket brass / steel pipe plug (1/8 NPT)
oil-gallery-pipe-plug-closure.function: Hermetically seals drilled longitudinal oil galleries in the crankcase casting.
oil-gallery-pipe-plug-closure.operatingConditions: Tapered pipe thread holding 60 psi hot engine oil pressure.

starter-adapter-assembly.name: Starter Adapter Assembly
starter-adapter-assembly.material: Worm drive shaft, gear, and wrap-spring overrunning clutch assembly
starter-adapter-assembly.function: Engages electric starter torque to crank engine, disengaging automatically when engine fires.
starter-adapter-assembly.operatingConditions: Wrap-spring clutch tightens during cranking; releases cleanly once engine exceeds starter rpm.

alternator-drive-coupling.name: Alternator Drive & Coupling
alternator-drive-coupling.material: Carburized bevel gear with elastomeric / spring shock-absorbing drive hub
alternator-drive-coupling.function: Drives the 28V 70A aircraft alternator while dampening high-frequency torsional pulses.
alternator-drive-coupling.operatingConditions: Gear ratio approximately 3:1 to provide adequate electrical charging at engine idle.

magneto-accessory-drive-coupling.name: Magneto Accessory Drive & Coupling
magneto-accessory-drive-coupling.material: Precision ground drive shaftgear with four-lug elastomer cushion drive blocks
magneto-accessory-drive-coupling.function: Drives aircraft high-tension magneto at exact engine speed with impulse vibration isolation.
magneto-accessory-drive-coupling.operatingConditions: Elastomer rubber blocks cushion magneto internal drive gears and timing gears.

fuel-injection-pump-drive.name: Fuel Injection Pump Drive
fuel-injection-pump-drive.material: Carburized splined shaftgear with precision mounting flange
fuel-injection-pump-drive.function: Drives positive displacement rotary fuel injection pump in direct synchronization with engine rpm.
fuel-injection-pump-drive.operatingConditions: Supplies fuel flow proportional to engine speed to maintain proper mixture metering.
fuel-injection-pump-drive.source: IPC X-30040A Fig. 30 #1; Manual Sec. III

propeller-governor-drive-gear.name: Propeller Governor Drive Gear
propeller-governor-drive-gear.material: Precision bevel gear with Woodruff keyway
propeller-governor-drive-gear.function: Drives the aircraft propeller constant-speed governor from the front of the camshaft.
propeller-governor-drive-gear.operatingConditions: Drives governor flyweights and high-pressure oil boost pump.

mechanical-tachometer-drive-housing.name: Mechanical Tachometer Drive & Housing
mechanical-tachometer-drive-housing.material: Precision 90 deg bevel gear drive in cast aluminum housing
mechanical-tachometer-drive-housing.function: Drives aircraft mechanical RPM indicator cable at 0.5:1 engine camshaft speed.
mechanical-tachometer-drive-housing.operatingConditions: Standard aircraft SAE 7/8-18 threaded mechanical tachometer drive port.

auxiliary-accessory-pad-drive-bearings.name: Auxiliary Accessory Pad Drive & Bearings
auxiliary-accessory-pad-drive-bearings.material: Precision ground spur gearing, needle bearings, and cast aluminum pad closure
auxiliary-accessory-pad-drive-bearings.function: Provides auxiliary drive pads for vacuum pumps, hydraulic pumps, or secondary alternators.
auxiliary-accessory-pad-drive-bearings.operatingConditions: Lubricated by accessory case internal splash.

crankcase-primary-external-fastener.name: Crankcase Primary External Fastener
crankcase-primary-external-fastener.function: Secures external end of primary through-bolts clamping main bearing saddles.
